ruleHair: Never change her hair or eye color.
rulePurple: Never use purple brand accents on her.
ruleLogo: Never replace the geometric M logo with a mascot icon in a favicon, PWA, app icon or wordmark.

ruleLicense: Never claim the artwork is open-source, AGPL-3.0 or freely reusable.

licenseDetail: The artwork is proprietary. Use on Yuri’s own properties and within authorized Mnerys installations follows the mascot license. Independent use by third parties requires express written permission.
faqQuestions: Can I use Nery in my own project?
Can I turn off the animations and speech?
faqAnswers: Nery is Yuri Cunha’s personal mascot and a member of the Mizuki family. She appears in his projects, products and websites, including Mnerys.

Nery was created for Yuri and his projects. Independent use, redistribution or adaptation requires his express written permission. The full mascot license explains the limited display permission within Mnerys.
Yes. Open Settings at the top of the page to pause animations, hide the walking Nery or switch off speech. Your device’s reduced-motion preference is respected automatically.
